summary: Implemented Gotify Adapter v1 as a bounded local-first transport for Notification Router recall events, including dry-run validation, token-safe reports, missing-configuration handling, retry-once delivery, CLI test command, and unit tests.
known_limitations: Real Gotify delivery requires ESTATE_GOTIFY_URL and ESTATE_GOTIFY_TOKEN to be provided at runtime; no credentials are stored in the repository.
The adapter only delivers Notification Router recall events that are eligible for immediate delivery; informational events are skipped.
